alt: 一人張開雙臂站在海邊，眺望寬闊的海面和天空。
scene_prompt: Wide peaceful seaside panorama: immense pale blue sky and open sea meet at a distant horizon, small white clouds and gulls, a little grassy coastal bluff in foreground. One small person stands with relaxed open arms gazing toward the expansive horizon, conveying open-hearted freedom and spacious peaceful mood. The landscape dominates, no buildings or writing.
